meta.source: Captured from the live CSS of vancouverpsychologycentre.com (vpc.css custom properties and computed styles), November 16, 2026

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on white, snow, lime-soft and lime. Also the text color on lime buttons.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary headings and strong supporting text on white or snow.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Body copy and subheads on white (4.6:1). Avoid on footer-mid or darker grounds.

tokens.name: green-deep
tokens.usage: Ghost button text and border, links, and text on lime-soft. The darkest brand green.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The signature brand color: primary buttons, the header 'Book a call' pill, card CTAs. Always carries ink text, never white.

tokens.name: lime-deep
tokens.usage: Hero highlight block behind the italic word, eyebrow labels and specialty tag text. Below 4.5:1 on white (3.0:1): use for 18px+ or bold uppercase labels only.

tokens.name: lime-mid
tokens.usage: Decorative accents and hover tints. Not for text.

tokens.name: lime-soft
tokens.usage: Hero background wash and specialty tag fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders.

tokens.name: snow
tokens.usage: Alternate section background and photo placeholders.

tokens.name: footer-bg
tokens.usage: Footer background.

tokens.name: footer-mid
tokens.usage: Footer dividers and inner panels.

tokens.name: trust-bg
tokens.usage: Warm neutral band behind the press and 'As seen in' row.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page background and card surfaces.

tokens.name: logo-lime
tokens.usage: The lime of the VPC monogram in the logo file. For the logo only, not UI.

tokens.name: logo-gray
tokens.usage: The gray of the logo wordmark. For the logo only, not UI text (fails contrast).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps, tag vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Small button vertical padding, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tag horizontal padding, gaps between inline items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding and button horizontal padding (small).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side padding at desktop (the site uses clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px)).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section top padding, e.g. the footer.

tokens.name: max-width
tokens.usage: Content column maximum width.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Skip link and small panels.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Clinician photos and small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Audience selector cards and the hero highlight block.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Specialty tags.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: All buttons and CTAs. Buttons are always pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Audience selector cards. A soft green-tinted lift, the only shadow in the system.
